description: Defines the CKEDITOR.dom.event class, representing a native DOM event object with methods for event handling such as getKey, getKeystroke, preventDefault, stopPropagation, and getTarget. Also includes constants for CTRL, SHIFT, and ALT keys.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.event
classes.description: Represents a native DOM event object with methods to access event properties and control event behavior.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key code associated with the event.

methods.name: getKeystroke
methods.description: Returns a number representing the combination of keys pressed, including control, shift, and alt modifiers.

methods.name: preventDefault
methods.description: Prevents the default action of the event and optionally stops propagation.

methods.name: stopPropagation
methods.description: Stops the event from propagating further.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the DOM node targeted by the event.
